framing.lineOfInquiry: Gopi Dhillon (P00024) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE019
framing.alternate: Gopi Dhillon (P00024) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Gopi Dhillon's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Location inconsistency (impossible): Chandigarh Railway Station → Andheri East Offices, Mumbai, 1347.82 km in 9.4 min
Location inconsistency (requires air travel): Andheri East Offices, Mumbai → an unnamed place, 1351.52 km in 168.1 min
The record placing them near the scene (LOCATION) is only accurate to about 2.2 km
The record placing them near the scene (CDR) is only accurate to about 1.5 km

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

alternateHypotheses.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
alternateHypotheses.statement: Some records attributed to Gopi Dhillon were generated by another person using the same phone or handset.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Handset IMEI-351746120047113 is also used by P00023 — another person may have generated some records

alternateHypotheses.test: Handset forensics and SIM CAF/KYC; establish who carried the handset at the incident time (the other user's location, CCTV).

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Gopi Dhillon was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 53 other days (27 Feb – 07 May), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Gopi Dhillon was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Gopi Dhillon's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak
